synthesis.body: Bare attribute accesses like [errno.EOPNOTSUPP, errno.ENOSYS] inside a @pytest.mark.parametrize list are evaluated when pytest collects the module, not when the test runs. An AttributeError silently fails the *entire module*'s collection. Mirror any production-code getattr guard (e.g. _LOCK_UNSUPPORTED_ERRNOS) with an equivalent list comprehension at the module level instead.

title: pytest.mark.parametrize list items evaluated at collection time
